notes: Reached entirely through the Claude-in-Chrome connector in a dedicated tab; no HTTP-layer tooling. robots.txt names no Claude/anthropic-ai/ClaudeBot agent and does not disallow /categories/ or /kategorien/ - only account, newsletter, catalogue-info and ?pagedef/?listpage filter URLs are blocked. Platform is Intershop and fully server-rendered, so after loading /en/categories/furniture in the tab every further page was pulled with same-origin fetch() from that page context and parsed in-page. No 403, CAPTCHA or rate-limit at any point (about 60 requests, paced 0.7-1.2s). TREE = union of three sources as required: (a) mega-menu plus category tile strip on /en/categories/furniture, (b) /sitemap_categories_de.xml (183 category URLs, German slugs), (c) each parent page's own child chip strip. The sitemap was the richer source for the indoor branch - it added Armchairs, Daybeds, Deckchairs, Hammocks, Swivel chairs and Furniture accessories, none of which appear in the English mega-menu, and it also added Garden shelves, Outdoor stools and Outdoor serving trolleys, which the Garden furniture chip strip does not show. The chip strips added nothing beyond filter pages. German slugs were mapped to English URLs via each page's hreflang=en alternate; every English URL was then confirmed to return 200 with a matching h1 AND a canonical equal to the requested path (bad-slug trap check). The only mismatch was /en/categories/furniture/armchairs, which canonicalises to /en/categories/furniture/chairs/armchairs, so the canonical form is recorded. DUPLICATE ALIASES DROPPED: /kategorien/moebel/sitzmoebel serves the identical page as /kategorien/moebel/stuehle (h1 Stuehle, breadcrumb Home>Moebel>Stuehle, same 915 count) and /kategorien/moebel/aufbewahrung serves the identical page as /kategorien/moebel/regale (h1 Regale, 473). Both aliases dropped; only the canonical nodes (Chairs, Shelves) kept. QTY METHOD: rendered header first - the site prints 'N of TOTAL products' under the grid whenever a category exceeds one page of 40 tiles. For categories with fewer than 40 products no header renders at all; for those the count is the number of unique product item_ids inside the page's single .snippetProductListModuleStandard grid, read from the data-ecommerce-item JSON on each tile. That fallback was validated against the header method: on Sofas (header 276) and Closets (header 100) the same selector returns exactly 40 tiles, i.e. one full page, so on a sub-40 page it returns the complete listing. Exactly one product-list module exists per page, so there is no recommendation-carousel contamination. Note that a tile's item_category field is the product's PRIMARY category, not the listing category (all 39 tiles on Chests of drawers are tagged 'closets'; Deckchairs' 23 tiles include 10 tagged 'garden-loungers') - that is legitimate multi-tagging, so counts are NOT filtered by that field. Counts vary per category, so no site-wide constant is being echoed back. CHILD-EXCEEDS-PARENT / COVERAGE: recorded verbatim and flagged, not 'fixed'. Chairs' own listing reports 915 while its two children total 396; Tables reports 968 against six children totalling 931; Garden furniture reports 986 against thirteen children totalling 1016. Per the hierarchy rule those three parents are grouping rows with qty null. EXCLUDED: Lighting (whole department, including Outdoor > Outdoor lamps) and Mirrors - other tasks. Filter/refinement pages absent from the category sitemap: furniture/upholstered, /sustainable, /recycled-materials, chairs/wood, the shelves colour+material chips, garden-tables/extendable, garden-tables/foldable, garden-furniture/metal, garden-furniture/stackable. Design-classics roll-ups (klassiker/moebel-klassiker, stuhl-klassiker, sofa-klassiker) excluded as curated collection pages. Furniture accessories (moebelzubehoer) excluded as furniture parts/care. Parasols excluded as a shade product. Outdoor BBQs/grills/fireplaces, flower boxes, garden accessories and outdoor textiles excluded. The Accessories department (decoration, kitchenware, baskets & storage, bath accessories, fireplaces), Textiles and High-tech contain no furniture nodes - checked against the full 183-URL category sitemap. This site has no kids/nursery, bathroom-furniture or office-furniture department.
